description_full: ADI Global Distribution Inc. operates as a distributor of security, AV, and smart living products in the United States and internationally. The company sells video surveillance, power, automation, access control, AV, fire, intrusion, smart living, communications, and datacom and networking products. ADI Global Distribution Inc. was founded in 1929 and is based in Melville, New York.

culture_narrative: Employs approximately 4K people. Revenue per employee of $1.2M ranks in the top quartile among Technology peers. Stock-based compensation of $6K per employee reflects an ownership culture.
financial_summary: ADI Global Distribution Inc. is a small-cap technology business with a $766M market cap on $4.8B of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at +16% over the past three years, the kind of sustained demand persistence that marks a compounder.

Returns on capital run at 5% against a 8% cost of capital, which means the business is destroying value with every dollar it reinvests, and 20% gross margins are typical of commodity economics where competitors can replicate the product cheaply.
The company is burning through $576M of cash, and without positive owner earnings any valuation rests on hope rather than evidence.
On the balance sheet, debt is moderate at 3.9× net debt/EBITDA, serviceable in normal conditions but worth watching through a downturn, and interest coverage runs at 3.5×.

Shareholder yield is only 0.0%, a thin return of capital, and insider ownership is negligible, so management has little personal stake in the long-term outcome, and profit capture is only 0.2× the fair share, suggesting no structural edge inside its industry.
